title: SCOUT
current_action: Ask AI for three very different approaches.
current_question: What would a genuinely different approach look like?
current_activity: Name the current approach. Ask for three alternatives with different starting assumptions, then choose one difference worth exploring. Do not select a winner yet.
current_facilitator_Ask: What different approaches have you considered?
current_Try_invitation: Would it help to explore three different approaches?
strengths: Ask elicits existing thinking before options; Try separates contrasting assumptions from choosing a winner; Guide explicitly permits rejecting AI.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: The broad Ask and optional human-only invitation lead to an AI-specific action on Classic Try. This is a voluntary tool experiment, not a contradiction, but the main face alone does not explain the human route.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain the non-leading shared Ask. If a shorter human-only route is needed, place it in Try support rather than making Ask an AI instruction.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner can compare their own alternatives; a team can offer options before grouping them without voting yet.
relationship_audit: Discovery of existing alternatives → optional contrast exploration → activity distinguishes assumptions → notices/follow-ups defer choosing; AI help proposes differences only after listening.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Ask a reader to name one genuinely different assumption and choose whether to explore it, including a no-AI choice.
tradeoff: A visible route choice costs space; adding it to every opening would make discovery tool-led.

title: FOG AHEAD
current_action: Ask AI to ask you one clarifying question at a time.
current_question: Which unanswered question would most change our next step?
current_activity: Give a short, non-sensitive challenge description. Answer up to three clarifying questions, one at a time. Stop and rewrite the challenge using what changed; do not let questioning replace action.
current_facilitator_Ask: What are you hoping to accomplish?
current_Try_invitation: Would one clarifying question at a time help?
strengths: Learner-defined purpose precedes tools; one-question-at-a-time activity has a stop/restate boundary; Try cues guard against endless clarification.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Base AI template says after three questions, whereas activity says up to three and Guide says stop when enough is clear. A literal separate AI session could continue after useful clarity.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Consider aligning the optional AI template with the existing early-stop permission; preserve the broad goal Ask used by Unclear.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner restates their goal; a team corrects the restatement without requiring everyone to answer each question.
relationship_audit: Goal discovery → optional incremental clarification → bounded questions and restatement → notices stop at useful clarity; AI template’s after-three phrasing is the residual mismatch.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: In a mock exchange where the first answer resolves uncertainty, check whether the learner can stop and act.
tradeoff: A flexible stop is less mechanically predictable but avoids a question quota.

title: CHECK BEARINGS
current_action: Which claims need checking? Verify one independently.
current_question: Which claim would matter most if it were wrong?
current_activity: Select one consequential factual claim. Use AI or tools if helpful to check original sources, direct observations or trusted references. Look for actual evidence, not model agreement. If you cannot check it now, label it unverified and do not use it to justify a risky action.
current_facilitator_Ask: Which part would matter most if it were wrong?
current_Try_invitation: Would it help to check one claim together?
strengths: Ask prioritizes consequence and enough evidence for intended use; activity explicitly permits AI/tool-assisted checking grounded in original sources or observation; unavailable checks stay unverified.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Classic action says independently, which can be read as forbidding AI although activity permits it. Coaching E imports only the invitation, not the evidence procedure or unverified-risk boundary.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Preserve evidence independence, tool assistance and proportionality. Add local Coaching activity support if independence of use is intended; do not expand shared invitation into a full audit.
individual_team_adaptation: A person can inspect one claim; a team can divide approved checks and compare actual evidence rather than model votes.
relationship_audit: Consequence-based inquiry → evidence-enough follow-up → optional single-claim check → actual evidence, uncertainty and safe-use limits; optional AI can find sources/run checks without being its own proof.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Executed approved commands and observed results adapt original evidence; missing dependencies/denied permissions are not passing checks, and consequential evidence can be inspected with tools.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Offer a confident but unsupported answer; see whether a reader can choose an appropriate check and leave an unavailable claim unverified.
tradeoff: More explicit evidence language reduces ambiguity but must not imply exhaustive human checking.

title: SMALL STEPS
current_action: Ask AI for a test you can finish in ten minutes.
current_question: What can we learn with a small, safe test rather than a full build?
current_activity: Choose one uncertain assumption. Define a reversible test with an observable result and a stop condition. Use synthetic or approved material, run the test, and record what it did and did not show.
current_facilitator_Ask: What would be useful to learn from your next attempt?
current_Try_invitation: Would a small, safe test help you learn more?
strengths: Ask centers the learner’s desired learning; activity specifies an uncertain assumption, reversible test, observation and stop; Guide preserves limits of a small result.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Classic main action centers an AI-generated ten-minute test while Ask and activity support wider experimentation. STUCK-E01 does not carry the canonical test steps. Agent adaptation emphasizes implementation scope rather than the base card’s test learning.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Preserve the safe-test procedure and agent scope controls as distinct adaptations. Supply a concise local Coaching run cue rather than treating the invitation as complete steps.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner chooses the uncertainty; a team agrees scope and observation without the mentor designing the experiment for them.
relationship_audit: Learner chooses what to learn → optional reversible test → assumption, observation and stop → notices limit conclusions; optional AI helps plan/build, not choose the goal.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Narrow implementation scope adapts a safe small step but is not identical to a learning test. Both tool notes explicitly make prompting supplementary to actual permission controls.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Ask readers to identify what they will observe and when they will stop before running a harmless example.
tradeoff: Operational detail improves independent use but can overburden a quick invitation if placed on the front.

title: NEW PERSPECTIVE
current_action: Ask AI to critique the idea as its intended user.
current_question: What might the person using this find difficult?
current_activity: Describe an intended user without identifying them. Ask AI for possible difficulties, then separate plausible concerns from guesses. Choose one question to ask a real user; simulated feedback is not user research.
strengths: Simulated user critique is explicitly hypothetical; one real-user question prevents simulation from masquerading as research; generic needs reduce unnecessary disclosure.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: The AI-first action can sound like permission to speak for a user until the activity qualification is read; no paired private Guide is authored for this catalog-only card.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain the actual-user boundary. For future selection, keep the hypothesis warning visible before any simulated feedback; no need to force this into Classic12.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner lists tentative concerns; a team separates guesses from observed feedback and agrees one respectful question.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Ask whether the simulated concern counts as actual user evidence; reader should say no and propose a real question.
tradeoff: A short warning uses space but protects the distinctive simulation-versus-evidence distinction.

title: FALSE SUMMIT
current_action: Ask: How could this fail? Test one failure mode.
current_question: Which plausible failure could we safely expose now?
current_activity: List possible failures and choose one low-risk case. Test with synthetic input in a sandbox or on paper. Stop if testing would affect real users, private data or live systems.
strengths: One safely exposed failure is a focused experiment; sandbox, synthetic input and live-user stop boundaries make the activity feasible without a full build.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: The action’s broad how-could-this-fail framing can invite a long speculative list; the activity narrows it to one low-risk case. Not every project has a suitable sandbox.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep the one-case choice and paper route; do not turn a hypothetical failure list into evidence or require a technical sandbox.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner can walk through a paper case; a team agrees a harmless failure to inspect rather than distributing blame.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Check that the proposed test affects no real user, private record or live service and yields an actual observation.
tradeoff: Narrow safe cases leave important higher-stakes failures untested and must be labeled as such.

title: TRAVEL LIGHT
current_action: Try a fresh chat with only the essential context.
current_question: What is the smallest context someone needs to help us?
current_activity: Write a compact task brief with the goal, necessary constraints and one sanitized example. Start a fresh chat using that brief. Keep safety requirements; do not drop essential context merely to shorten it.
strengths: Fresh context is coupled with a goal, constraints and sanitized example; safety requirements cannot be shortened away; the AI template asks rather than invents missing essentials.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: A fresh chat is an AI-specific optional experiment, not a general unstick remedy. Copying a brief can drop prior approvals or unresolved limits even when it feels concise.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep the brief’s essentials and treat a human handoff as a possible adaptation, not a required replacement for the chat experiment.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner writes a reusable brief; a team checks constraints and permission boundaries before another person or tool receives it.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Give the brief to a new reader and ask them to identify the goal, constraint and next safe step without seeing the old chat.
tradeoff: Short briefs reduce clutter but cannot replace needed evidence or permission history.

title: LEAVE MARKERS
current_action: Save a useful prompt. Explain why it helped.
current_question: Which part of this prompt made the result more useful?
current_activity: Save a sanitized prompt in an approved team workspace. Note the task, the useful instruction and where it might not transfer. Team Trail can mark the card used; it is not a free-text prompt notebook.
strengths: Sanitized reuse includes task context and transfer limits; AI causal explanations are hypotheses; explicit external-workspace storage avoids claiming a notebook exists on-device.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: The question presupposes the prompt caused usefulness; activity and AI template appropriately limit causal confidence, but a learner may encounter only the question.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: For any future paired surface, allow no identifiable prompt effect and preserve context/transfer limits rather than rewarding prompt collection.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner can keep a local approved note; a team chooses what to share without preserving private transcript content.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Ask the reader to state a reuse limit and distinguish a plausible helpful instruction from proof of causation.
tradeoff: Saving fewer contextualized examples may be more useful than a large decontextualized library.

title: MAP THE GAPS
current_action: Ask AI to separate known facts from its assumptions.
current_question: What did we supply as evidence, and what is being filled in?
current_activity: Take one AI answer. Mark claims grounded in the supplied material, assumptions and unanswered questions. Have a person check those labels against the original material; AI's own labels are not verification.
strengths: Evidence, assumptions and unanswered questions are separated; AI self-labeling is explicitly not verification. Agent adaptation preserves read-before-edit and active-instruction discovery.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Have a person check those labels can sound like checking every label even for low-consequence exploratory work. Agent check is orientation, not proof the whole repository is understood.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Frame any future guidance around a bounded sample and consequence-appropriate source checks, while retaining human accountability and no-edit discovery.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner selects a consequential claim; a team can split source checks without endorsing unsupported labels by consensus.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Read-before-edit repository orientation adapts evidence/assumption awareness; prompt, check and both instruction-discovery notes preserve uncertainty and prohibit project scripts. It does not verify a whole repository.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Insert one unsupported claim in supplied material and see whether it remains marked unsupported after source inspection.
tradeoff: Sampling reduces review effort but cannot support blanket claims that all content is verified.

title: SHOW THE TARGET
current_action: Give AI an example of what a good answer looks like.
current_question: What makes this example useful rather than merely polished?
current_activity: Use a non-sensitive example of a useful output. Name two qualities to preserve and one thing not to copy. Ask AI to apply the qualities to a new task, then check the result against them.
current_facilitator_Ask: What makes this example useful for what you want to do?
current_Try_invitation: Would it help to try those qualities in a small new example?
strengths: Revised Ask asks about usefulness for the learner’s purpose; Guide respects qualities a mentor may overlook; activity transfers qualities while excluding unnecessary copying.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: AI-RESULTS-Q03 assumes an example is available and useful; it can be awkward when the only output is disappointing. Coaching’s generic guidance helps diagnose fit but does not supply the missing example.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep the shared Ask for Classic; locally cue a useful example if available or permit another AI Results question when none is useful.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner names valued qualities; a team compares meanings of useful without making polish the single standard.
relationship_audit: Usefulness in an existing example → valued qualities → optional small transfer → activity preserves selected qualities and checks result; AI help demonstrates without unnecessary copying.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Test with both a valued exemplar and an unsatisfactory output; record whether readers can decline the presupposition or switch question.
tradeoff: A local fallback keeps Classic’s specificity; making the shared Ask generic could lose useful exemplar transfer.

title: MAKE CAMP
current_action: Summarize progress, open questions, and the next step.
current_question: What can the next person pick up without repeating our whole discussion?
current_activity: Say or write three bullets: progress supported by evidence, open questions and the next concrete action. Name an owner for the next action with their agreement. Keep private discussion out of shared summaries.
current_facilitator_Ask: What did you notice in that attempt?
current_Try_invitation: Would a short progress-and-next-step summary help?
strengths: Ask allows uncertainty or no lesson; Try organizes evidenced progress, open questions and a consensual next action; privacy and invented-owner safeguards persist in AI and agent variants.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Ask notices an attempt broadly, while Try moves specifically to a handoff summary. The distinction is coherent but should not be treated as a mandatory inference that reflection must produce a next action.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain both openings and optional summary; accept no change, an open question or stopping without manufacturing a lesson.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner leaves a note for their future self; a team confirms a next owner only if someone agrees.
relationship_audit: Notice the attempt without requiring a lesson → optional handoff summary → evidence/open questions/consenting owner → check summary fidelity; AI help organizes observations without inventing decisions.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Evidence-backed handoff adapts resumability; no secret data or unauthorized write/commit/push; both tool notes separate stable instructions from temporary progress.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: A new reader should distinguish what happened from what is open and should not infer an owner from silence.
tradeoff: Concise handoffs sacrifice conversational detail; preserve evidence needed for resumption, not every remark.

title: CHANGE COURSE
current_action: Ask AI for the strongest argument against your plan.
current_question: What would a thoughtful critic challenge first?
current_activity: Describe the plan and ask for a substantive objection, not an attack on people. Identify which concern has evidence and which is hypothetical. Choose whether it calls for a change or a test.
current_facilitator_Ask: What concerns, if any, do you have about this plan?
current_Try_invitation: Would it help to explore a good-faith objection?
strengths: Revised Ask explicitly permits no concerns; Guide says difference is not proof of a flawed plan; activity separates evidence from hypothetical objections and permits no change.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Main action requires an AI objection in this optional experiment and may pull attention back to critique even after no concerns. This is a framing tradeoff, not a logical failure.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep no-change and no-experiment outcomes explicit; use a human good-faith objection when useful, without making all concern exploration adversarial.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner can examine one concern; a team critiques the plan rather than a person and leaves disagreement visible.
relationship_audit: Concern inquiry allows none → optional good-faith objection → evidence versus hypothetical concern → change/test/no-change remains theirs; AI offer does not establish plan failure.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Present a sound plan with no reported concern and check whether the mentor can stop rather than manufacture an objection.
tradeoff: A strong objection can reveal blind spots but can also prolong deliberation without new evidence.

title: SIDE TRAIL
current_action: Borrow an approach from a different field. Name where the analogy breaks.
current_question: Who solves a similar problem in a very different setting?
current_activity: Pick a different field, such as libraries or gardening. Borrow one useful pattern for the challenge. Name one important difference that makes the analogy unreliable, then keep only the useful part.
strengths: Borrowed patterns come with an explicit break in the analogy; AI template forbids treating analogy as evidence; concrete non-coding fields broaden entry.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Requires finding a sufficiently different field and knowing enough to identify where the analogy breaks; a confident but unfamiliar analogy can conceal those limits.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain the boundary test; permit a familiar example or no useful analogy rather than force a clever comparison.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner chooses a familiar field; a team offers different analogies without needing one shared metaphor.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader should identify one useful pattern and one non-transferable difference before adopting anything.
tradeoff: More familiar analogies are accessible but may yield less novelty.

title: HUMAN FIRST
current_action: Sketch how to solve the problem without AI. Keeping that approach is a complete choice.
current_question: What would we do if AI were unavailable?
current_activity: Draw a three-step human-only workflow. Keeping it is a complete choice. If useful, compare a limited AI-assisted or hybrid option, including preparation, checking, corrections and learning value. Keep accountable human judgment visible; do not assume AI adds value.
current_facilitator_Ask: How would you approach this without AI?
current_Try_invitation: Would it help to sketch a human-only approach?
strengths: Human-only is a complete choice on main action, activity and Guide; optional comparison counts preparation, checking, corrections and learning value; judgment remains human.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Optional AI-help text invites a three-route comparison without repeating if desired, but its heading and surrounding guidance make it optional. EXPLORING-E01 carries neither the three-step method nor full comparison dimensions.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Preserve the complete human-only outcome and total-effort lens; add local Coaching method support only if needed, not mandatory AI comparison.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner sketches their own route; a team compares responsibilities and learning value, not just output speed.
relationship_audit: Human-only inquiry and complete choice → optional sketch → three-step human-only workflow → optional full-effort comparison; AI-help heading gates the separate comparison offer.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader can finish successfully with a human-only workflow and no AI call; any comparison includes downstream checking effort.
tradeoff: Detailed comparison can consume more effort than a small task warrants; stopping at human-only is legitimate.

title: WIDER HORIZON
current_action: Choose one constraint to relax and one to keep. Explore what becomes possible.
current_question: Which constraint is real, and which have we simply assumed?
current_activity: List three constraints. Mark which are confirmed and which are assumptions. Temporarily relax one assumption, not a safety or privacy requirement, and sketch a new option.
strengths: Confirmed constraints are distinguished from assumptions; safety/privacy cannot be relaxed; AI template asks what would need checking before use.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: A learner may not know whether a constraint is real, policy-based or merely assumed. The activity should not authorize experimentation outside their authority.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain the protected-constraint boundary; for uncertain authority, mark the constraint unknown and ask an appropriate person rather than relax it.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner checks one assumption; a team records who can clarify a constraint without silently voting away a requirement.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Include a safety constraint among three examples and check it is never selected for relaxation.
tradeoff: Authority checks can slow exploration but prevent treating all boundaries as negotiable.

title: NAME THE DESTINATION
current_action: State who needs what outcome, and how you will notice it helped.
current_question: Who is this for, and what should be different afterward?
current_activity: Complete: For [role], we want [outcome], so they can [benefit]. Choose one observable sign of progress and one thing outside scope. Let the team correct the sentence before using AI.
strengths: Outcome, benefit, observable progress and outside-scope boundary are defined before AI; needs and numerical targets cannot be invented.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Team-corrected wording assumes collaborators are present, and one observable sign cannot fully represent every meaningful benefit.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain as a strong Define anchor; adapt correction to a solo reread or appropriate beneficiary check, without turning one indicator into a score.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner writes a tentative sentence; a team corrects it, and absent beneficiaries remain assumptions to check.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader can name who benefits, what changes, one observation and one excluded scope item.
tradeoff: An observable sign makes progress discussable but should not narrow the project to what is easiest to count.

title: UNPACK THE WORD
current_action: Pick one vague word in the request. Replace it with an observable requirement.
current_question: What would better, faster or useful look like in practice?
current_activity: Circle one vague word in the task. Ask two people to explain what they mean by it, with passing allowed. Agree on a concrete example and a non-example, then rewrite the request.
strengths: Vague terms become examples and non-examples; multiple meanings are heard with passing allowed; AI waits for human choice before rewriting.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Ask two people requires adaptation for a solo learner; replacing a rich value word with a single requirement can lose important nuance.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Allow a solo learner to propose two interpretations or seek one collaborator later; keep unresolved meaning visible rather than force agreement.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo compares two meanings; a team invites meanings without pressuring anyone to justify passing.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Two readers should be able to distinguish the agreed example from the non-example and state any unresolved nuance.
tradeoff: Concrete criteria aid action but can prematurely freeze an evolving goal.

title: ONE VARIABLE
current_action: Change one part of a prompt. Compare the outputs against the same criterion.
current_question: What changed, and can we reasonably connect it to this one difference?
current_activity: Keep the task and input fixed. Change one prompt instruction, compare results against one agreed criterion and note variability. One comparison is a clue, not a reliable performance estimate.
strengths: A single prompt difference is compared against an agreed criterion; variability and one-comparison limits are explicit; agent variant uses separate copies and review effort.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Agent variant compares tool/model approaches, not necessarily one variable, and leaves its confound caution in tool notes. It must not be presented as causal confirmation of the base experiment.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Preserve both exercises with distinct claims: narrow prompt comparison versus practical approach comparison. Keep baseline, review effort and limitations visible.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner can run two attempts; a team uses separate copies and shared acceptance checks without ranking people.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Separate-copy approach comparison preserves shared checks, scope and review effort, but not strict one-variable causality. Versions/settings/models and single-comparison limits must stay visible.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader should state the one changed instruction for base use, or multiple confounds for agent comparison, and avoid claiming a reliable winner.
tradeoff: Tighter control improves interpretability but may be less representative of real tool use.

title: TRAIL SAMPLE
current_action: Try the same task on an ordinary, an edge and an incomplete example.
current_question: Does our idea still help when the input is awkward or incomplete?
current_activity: Prepare three synthetic examples: ordinary, edge case and missing important information. Decide expected behavior before trying them. Check whether the system asks for missing information rather than guessing.
strengths: Ordinary, awkward and incomplete examples are selected before use; expected behavior is defined first; clarification rather than guessing is observable.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Three synthetic examples cannot establish robustness. AI-generated examples may miss the same failure the system has, despite the human expectation check.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep this a small diagnostic sample; add learner-chosen cases when relevant rather than a large compulsory evaluation suite.
individual_team_adaptation: A solo learner predicts behavior; a team can each propose one synthetic case and compare observations.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Incomplete case should elicit a clarification or explicit limitation, not an invented fact.
tradeoff: Broader cases take effort; three cases support local learning, not general performance claims.

title: PAPER BRIDGE
current_action: Act out a workflow on paper before connecting tools or automating it.
current_question: Where should a person review or stop this workflow?
current_activity: Sketch the input, proposed AI step, human review and final action. Walk through one synthetic example. Mark where permission, correction or stopping is needed before building any integration.
strengths: Paper enactment precedes integration; permission, correction and stopping points are explicit; template forbids execution.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Activity prescribes an AI step and human review even where neither is needed for the learner’s chosen human-only workflow; suitable for an optional automation experiment, not every project.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain the optional automation focus; when adapting to a non-AI workflow, locate actual authority and risk gates rather than insert ceremonial reviews.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo walks through a synthetic example; team members can enact roles while decision authority remains explicit.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader should identify which step can change external state and stop before it without permission.
tradeoff: More gates improve control for risky actions but unnecessary gates can swamp a low-risk task.

title: FOLLOW THE SOURCE
current_action: Open one cited source. Check that it exists and supports the actual claim.
current_question: Does this source support these words, or only a nearby topic?
current_activity: Inspect an original cited source, including its context and applicability. Compare it with the exact claim. If unavailable, mark the claim unverified; do not accept a convincing-looking citation alone.
strengths: Checks actual source existence, context and applicability against the exact claim; nearby-topic citations are not accepted; unavailable means unverified.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Original-source access may exceed the nominal four minutes; the AI prompt only sees a supplied excerpt and cannot establish full-source context on its own.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep exact-support focus and unavailable fallback; use AI to navigate or compare evidence, not substitute an excerpt judgment for full applicability when consequence requires it.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo opens one source; team divides selected consequential claims and shares exact supporting context.

suggested_validation_NOT_run: Use a real source that mentions the topic but does not support the claim; reader should mark unsupported.
tradeoff: Deep source context can be costly, so prioritize consequence rather than require every citation to be exhausted.

title: FIND THE EXCEPTION
current_action: Look for a counterexample before treating an attractive claim as a rule.
current_question: What plausible case would make this claim fail?
current_activity: Rewrite the claim so it can be checked. Suggest a counterexample and test it against supplied evidence or a safe direct check. If it fails, narrow the claim; if it survives, do not call that proof.
strengths: A claim is made checkable and challenged with a plausible counterexample; surviving one case is explicitly not proof; hypothetical examples stay labeled.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Some meaningful claims are qualitative or cannot be safely tested directly; inventing a counterexample can be mistaken for observing one if the activity is rushed.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain evidence-versus-hypothesis distinction; permit a narrower claim or an open question when a safe check is unavailable.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo tests one boundary; a team can nominate a counterexample without treating disagreement as obstruction.

optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader can distinguish a proposed counterexample from a tested one and narrow the claim only when evidence warrants.
tradeoff: Counterexample search improves caution but can delay action when a bounded decision already has sufficient evidence.

title: MEASURE TWICE
current_action: Recheck one number with a calculator or code. Include units and assumptions.
current_question: Are the inputs, units and calculation all correct?
current_activity: Select a consequential number. Trace its inputs, recalculate independently using a calculator or code, and check units and rounding. A matching calculation cannot rescue unreliable inputs.
strengths: Tool-based recalculation includes inputs, units, assumptions and rounding; matching arithmetic does not rescue bad inputs; AI cannot claim unused-tool verification.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Calculator/code output is not automatically a trustworthy independent check if it repeats the same mistaken formula or input. No need for exhaustive numerical review.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep one consequential-number focus; inspect source inputs and formula as well as the recomputed result with tools suited to the task.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo checks one calculation; a team can have someone restate inputs and units before running an approved check.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Provide a matching calculation with a unit error; reader should reject correctness despite numerical agreement.
tradeoff: Input tracing can dominate arithmetic effort but is often the decisive check.

title: SAFE TO SHARE
current_action: Before submitting a prompt, remove private details and use synthetic examples where possible.
current_question: What information does this task really require us to share?
current_activity: Review the proposed input locally before sending anything. Remove identifying, confidential and unnecessary details; follow the tool's approved-use policy. If unsure, use a synthetic example or do not submit it.
strengths: Local review occurs before submission; removal, approved-use policy, synthetic alternative and not-submit option are clear. Agent variant broadens to scoped side effects and refusal without workaround.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: De-identification alone does not guarantee appropriate sharing; deciding what is unnecessary may need local context. Agent permission pause is broader than base input privacy and should not replace it.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Preserve both privacy and action-permission checks; keep synthetic or no-submit fallback when uncertainty remains, without promising anonymization.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo reviews only information they are authorized to share; team confirms authority without pooling private records into a prompt.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Permission pause broadens privacy to reads, writes, external access and recovery; check and both tool notes preserve scoped approval, refusal and no bypass. Input privacy remains separately necessary.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: A sample with an indirect identifier should be replaced by synthetic context or withheld before any tool call.
tradeoff: Less shared detail may reduce usefulness; that does not authorize exposing private data.

title: SURPRISE ON THE TRAIL
current_action: Compare what you expected with what happened. Name one surprise.
current_question: What surprised us enough to change our understanding?
current_activity: Each person may name an expectation and an observation, with passing allowed. Separate what happened from your explanation for it. Choose one uncertainty to investigate rather than forcing a lesson.
strengths: Expectations and observations are distinguished from explanations; passing is allowed; no lesson is forced despite the surprise framing.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Action asks for a surprise and question asks for changed understanding; a routine result may not supply either. The activity’s no-forced-lesson safeguard is less visible.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: For a future visible prompt, permit nothing surprising or no change while retaining the distinctive expectation-observation comparison.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo can make a private comparison; team invites volunteers and preserves differing interpretations.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Use an unsurprising result and check that a reader can report no surprise without inventing learning.
tradeoff: Removing every presupposition can flatten a memorable reflective opening; a short fallback may suffice.

title: KEEP OR ADAPT
current_action: Name one move to keep, one to change and one thing you still cannot conclude.
current_question: What is worth repeating, and what should change next time?
current_activity: Review one completed attempt. Name a useful move, a specific adjustment and a limit of the evidence. If using Team Trail later, attach feedback only to the attempt actually recorded, not the team's overall performance.
current_facilitator_Ask: What is working well that you would like to keep?
current_Try_invitation: Would it help to review one attempt together?
strengths: Revised Ask starts with useful strengths; Guide avoids causal overreach; activity keeps adjustment and limits visible without rating people; agent review is read-only and not independent proof.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Ask presupposes something worth keeping; Guide should not manufacture progress. Mandatory-looking one keep/one change in the base action can exceed what an inconclusive attempt supports.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Preserve strengths-based shared Ask and no-invented-progress Coaching guidance; permit no justified change or only uncertainty when adapting Try.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo identifies evidence-supported moves; team discusses the attempt, not overall team ability or performance.
relationship_audit: Strengths inquiry → optional attempt review → keep/adjust/evidence limits → avoid causal claims and team ratings; AI only organizes observations. Broad Ask does not require every Try slot.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Read-only diff review adapts reflective inspection; no edits/discard and checked explanations protect existing work. Both tool notes reject a second agent as independent proof.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: With an inconclusive attempt, readers should leave a conclusion open rather than fabricate a keep/change claim.
tradeoff: A simple reflection structure is useful, but treating every slot as required creates false conclusions.

title: TEACH THE NEXT GUIDE
current_action: Explain one useful lesson to a teammate in plain language. Invite a correction.
current_question: Could someone else use this lesson without our original context?
current_activity: One volunteer explains a technique using a synthetic example. A teammate restates it and asks a question; passing is welcome. Notice what needs clarification and revise the explanation together.
strengths: Plain-language explanation, synthetic example and invited correction test transfer; restatement makes understanding observable; volunteering and passing protect participation.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Activity assumes a teammate and a useful lesson already exists; AI-written explanations may appear transferable before anyone can actually use them.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Allow solo teach-back or a future reader to test the explanation; do not force a lesson when there is none yet.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo records or rehearses a plain explanation; team has a willing listener restate or try it without public performance pressure.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: A new reader can explain a limit or apply the example without reconstructing the original chat.
tradeoff: Teach-back takes time and should not become a compulsory demonstration or learner score.

title: NAME THE BLOCKER
current_action: Decide whether you lack information, a decision or a workable next action.
current_question: What is stopping us right now, in one sentence?
current_activity: Each person may name the blocker. Agree whether the next move is to obtain information, ask a decision-maker or reduce the task. Pick one action that addresses that blocker instead of generating more ideas.
current_facilitator_Ask: What have you tried so far?
current_Try_invitation: Would it help to name the blocker before making more ideas?
strengths: Ask hears the learner’s account before labeling a blocker; conditional unhelpful-output follow-up is genuinely conditional; Try accepts coexisting blockers and asks for one useful action.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Base classification offers information, decision or action but may not capture fatigue, access, external constraints or a wish to stop. Coaching imports the Ask, not this conditional follow-up or optional AI-help field.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep open discovery and the multiple-blocker cue; treat categories as aids rather than diagnosis. Do not import a disappointing-output follow-up into every use.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo may name one blocker or stop; team can acknowledge different blockers without requiring consensus on causes.
relationship_audit: History before diagnosis → conditional least-useful question only for a reported unhelpful output → optional blocker naming → action for one blocker with others still visible; AI cannot decide their problem.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Present an access constraint and check the mentor does not force an information deficit or offer endless new ideas.
tradeoff: Simple categories make action easier but cannot cover every human or contextual obstacle.

title: SHRINK THE CLIMB
current_action: Replace the whole problem with one useful piece you can finish now.
current_question: What is the smallest piece that would still move us forward?
current_activity: Write the full task, then cross out everything not needed for one useful output. Pick a small deliverable, not a vague intention. Agree what done means and stop when it is met.
strengths: Small deliverable has a done condition, explicit exclusions and a stop; AI prompt retains essential safety checks.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Cross out everything not needed can be read as cutting prerequisites if not considered carefully; a five-minute target may not fit setup or permission work.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep the concrete deliverable focus and safety boundary; let the learner choose a sensible small scope rather than treating five minutes as a success metric.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo chooses one useful piece; team agrees dependencies and who can authorize the scope.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader should retain a required permission/check even when shrinking the deliverable and stop when the agreed result exists.
tradeoff: Smaller scope yields progress but may defer essential integration work, which should remain visible.

title: CHANGE THE MEDIUM
current_action: Stop editing the prompt. Sketch, sort or act out the problem instead.
current_question: What becomes clearer if we step away from the chat window?
current_activity: Choose paper, spoken explanation or movable notes. Represent the problem without AI for two minutes, then name one thing you could not see in the chat. Return to AI only if it serves a clear next step.
strengths: Directly permits stepping away from AI; paper, speech and movable notes widen access; return to AI needs a useful purpose rather than habit.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Activity asks for one thing not seen in chat, so may imply the medium change must reveal an insight; a no-change result is possible. Asking AI for the no-AI exercise is optional scaffolding, not a logical contradiction.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Allow no new insight and continue human-only if useful; retain accessible spoken and paper choices.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo sketches or speaks privately; team sorts movable notes or acts out the flow without requiring drawing skill.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader can choose a medium, stop after the short attempt and decline further AI use even without a new discovery.
tradeoff: A medium switch can reset attention but should not be forced when the current representation works.

title: QUIET FIRST
current_action: Give everyone quiet thinking time before discussion or AI suggestions.
current_question: What do we each notice before seeing someone else's answer?
current_activity: Allow one minute for private thinking, writing or drawing. Invite sharing without requiring it, then group contributions before asking AI. Offer a spoken or paired alternative for anyone who prefers it.
current_facilitator_Ask: How is working together going for you?
current_Try_invitation: Would a quiet minute before sharing help?
strengths: Revised Ask concerns the learner’s experience, not a diagnosis of quietness; independent thought, accessible alternatives, voluntary sharing and no invented agreement align across paired fields.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Classic activity ends with before asking AI, which can imply AI is the eventual destination although Guide permits later optional help. TEAM-E01 retains accessible alternatives in local guidance but lacks the canonical grouping method.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Preserve broad teamwork Ask and voluntary participation. If clarifying the base activity, make later AI conditional; keep any fuller Coaching activity support local.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo can pause before external suggestions; team offers writing, drawing, speech, pairs or passing without inferring ability or consent.
relationship_audit: Individual experience of teamwork → optional quiet minute → accessible private thought/voluntary sharing/grouping → protect distinct ideas and passing; AI organization is later help, not agreement detection.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: A person who passes should remain unranked and unpressured; distinct ideas should not be merged into invented consensus.
tradeoff: Quiet-first is one option, not a universally preferred participation style.

title: MAKE ROOM
current_action: Offer each person a turn, with an explicit option to pass or contribute another way.
current_question: What would you like to add, question or pass on?
current_activity: Invite a brief round without interruptions. State that passing is welcome and private or paired contributions are alternatives. Reflect back ideas without attaching judgments to who spoke or stayed quiet.
strengths: Invitations explicitly include passing, private or paired alternatives; ideas are reflected without judging who speaks; full activity serves as private REMIND-04.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: As a canonical activity it runs a brief round; as a Coaching reminder it is more procedural than the short general reminders and could be misread as an instruction to conduct a round now.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain optional invitation semantics. If shortening the shared activity, verify REMIND-04 still preserves passing, alternate modes and no-judgment safeguards, or author a local reminder instead.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo can choose a private contribution mode; team invites but does not allocate mandatory speaking turns.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Read REMIND-04 out of sequence and check that a mentor can apply the principle without starting a compulsory round.
tradeoff: Exact reuse prevents wording drift but makes a reminder inherit activity length and procedural framing.

title: PAIR BEFORE PLENARY
current_action: Let people test an idea with a partner before offering it to the whole team.
current_question: What feels easier to explore in a pair first?
current_activity: Offer pairs, solo reflection or a small group. Give a simple question and time to think. Invite volunteers to share a point, with permission before sharing a partner's contribution.
strengths: Pairs are offered alongside solo and small-group choices; partner permission is needed before sharing; AI prompt avoids disclosures and supplies a solo alternative.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Question what feels easier can presuppose pairs help; for some learners pairing adds social or access burden. The activity already offers sound alternatives.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain the options and permission boundary; no substantive rewrite required unless real use shows the question feels pressuring.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo reflection remains complete; a team uses voluntary pairs without assigning silent people to remediation.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader can decline a pair and withhold a partner’s contribution without explanation.
tradeoff: Offering multiple modes takes coordination but avoids treating pairs as universally accessible.

title: MISSING VOICE
current_action: Name an affected perspective that is absent. Record a question, not an invented answer.
current_question: Who might be affected but is not represented in this discussion?
current_activity: Name an absent role or access need without naming a person. Write a question for someone with that perspective and mark related assumptions untested. AI role-play cannot substitute for their participation.
strengths: Absent perspectives generate questions, not invented answers; role/access-need framing avoids identifying people; AI simulation cannot replace participation or infer demographic preferences.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Identifying an absent perspective does not establish that someone can or wants to participate, and a short exercise cannot represent every affected group.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep assumptions untested and seek appropriate voluntary input later; do not turn perspective mapping into demographic guessing.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo lists roles and questions; team records limits without appointing anyone spokesperson for an absent group.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader should produce a question to ask, not an AI-generated answer attributed to an absent person.
tradeoff: Real participation may take longer than the exercise; acknowledging absence is useful but not sufficient evidence.

title: PASS THE CONTROLS
current_action: Offer a new driver and a reviewer. Keep participation optional and accessible.
current_question: Would another role or way of contributing help someone participate?
current_activity: Offer roles such as prompt driver, questioner, reviewer or observer. Invite a voluntary swap and agree when to check in. Do not assume everyone wants to type, speak publicly or use the same interface.
strengths: Roles are varied, voluntary and accessible; observer/non-typing contribution counts; agent adaptation leaves role and approval choices with people and avoids permanent tool ownership.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Agent check says more than one person has a way to contribute, so it is team-specific, not a solo success requirement. Rotating roles does not itself prove meaningful inclusion.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep voluntary rotation and role choice; for solo work offer separate review moments rather than inventing a second person.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo can switch between drafting and checking; team offers roles without labeling people by ability or requiring a swap.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Voluntary driver/reviewer/questioner/observer roles adapt accessible participation; people allocate roles and approvals; tool notes preserve narration, evidence review and non-permanent ownership.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Someone can remain observer or decline typing while the team still recognizes their chosen contribution.
tradeoff: More roles can add coordination overhead; use only those the group finds useful.

title: CHOOSE THE COMPASS
current_action: Agree on two criteria before comparing options.
current_question: What should matter most in this choice?
current_activity: Name two criteria linked to the team's outcome. Separate mandatory safety or policy constraints from preferences. Compare options using available evidence and leave unknowns visible instead of inventing scores.
current_facilitator_Ask: What matters most in choosing your next step?
current_Try_invitation: Would agreeing on two criteria help you compare options?
strengths: Learner priorities and accepted tradeoffs guide choice; mandatory constraints are separated from preferences; unknowns remain visible instead of invented scores; agent variant plans acceptance checks before editing.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Exactly two criteria is a simplifying heuristic, not a sufficient model for every choice. Agent plan generation adapts the principle rather than literally comparing options.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Preserve the learner-owned shared Ask; keep mandatory constraints even when simplifying criteria and allow adaptation of the number.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo states personal priorities; team hears dissent and distinguishes agreed criteria from the mentor’s preferences.
relationship_audit: Learner priorities → acceptable tradeoff → optional criteria comparison → evidence and unknowns rather than scores; AI compares only their criteria and cannot decide.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Agreement on files, boundaries and acceptance checks adapts criteria-before-action; wait-for-agreement and no-edit/script limits preserve human authority. A plan does not authorize later actions.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Reader should identify an unknown and a non-negotiable constraint without converting either into an invented score.
tradeoff: Few criteria help action; too few can conceal a consequence that deserves separate review.

title: TWO TRAILS
current_action: Shortlist two options. Name what you gain and give up with each.
current_question: Which trade-off are we actually willing to accept?
current_activity: Use agreed criteria to narrow the list to two plausible options. For each, name a benefit, a cost and an uncertainty. Check dissenting concerns before choosing; do not keep generating alternatives by default.
strengths: Benefits, costs and uncertainty make tradeoffs explicit; dissent is checked; more ideas are not generated by default; AI cannot choose for the team.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Use agreed criteria presupposes a prior agreement, which a random standalone entry may not have; exactly two options can prematurely exclude a valuable route.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: For independent use, briefly invite criteria if none exist; keep two as an optional shortlist rather than a quota.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo compares two self-chosen possibilities; team surfaces dissent without treating majority agreement as evidence.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: Enter this card first with no prior criteria and check that readers can establish a useful comparison without another required card.
tradeoff: A shortlist reduces overload but can hide viable alternatives if used too early.

title: REVERSIBLE STEP
current_action: Choose a low-risk next step you can undo. Agree when to reconsider it.
current_question: Can we learn by moving without locking ourselves into this choice?
current_activity: Check authority, safety and reversibility first. If the step is low-risk, agree an owner, a stopping rule and a review point. If consequences are significant or hard to reverse, seek appropriate review instead.
strengths: Authority, risk and reversibility are checked before action; stopping/review point and higher-consequence escalation are explicit; agent recovery preserves unrelated work and rejects backup assumptions.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Reversibility in a practice copy cannot establish reversibility of external actions. Agree an owner should not be read as assigning one without consent.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain practice-copy scope and significant-consequence review; verify actual scoped recovery, not merely the presence of a checkpoint.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo confirms personal authority; team obtains an owner’s agreement and does not treat one person’s approval as universal authority.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: Disposable-copy scoped recovery adapts reversibility; initial-status inspection, approval and preservation of unrelated work survive. Tool notes require real recovery, not conversation/checkpoint assumptions.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: A recovery exercise should undo only the approved edit and preserve pre-existing work; do not execute it as part of this content review.
tradeoff: Practice recovery takes preparation but prevents treating undo as an abstract promise.

title: NAME THE OWNER
current_action: Turn the choice into one next action with an agreed owner and a done condition.
current_question: Who has agreed to do what, and how will we know it is done?
current_activity: State the next action plainly. Invite an owner to agree, define the visible result and identify any needed permission. Put follow-up details in an approved team workspace; Team Trail does not yet store free-text commitments.
strengths: A next action has an agreeing owner, observable done condition and permission; template cannot invent agreement; external-workspace boundary avoids claiming unsupported device storage.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: Turning every choice into an owned action can be inappropriate when the learner chooses to pause or no permission exists. Nominal three minutes does not include external coordination.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Keep this as an optional commitment aid after a real decision; permit a pending proposal or pause rather than forced assignment.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo agrees their own next step; team invites an owner rather than assigning from silence.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: With no volunteer or permission, the result remains unassigned/pending instead of an invented commitment.
tradeoff: Concrete commitments aid follow-through but should not convert exploratory conversation into an obligation.

title: CLOSE THE LOOP
current_action: Say what you chose, why, and what new evidence would make you revisit it.
current_question: Can everyone tell what was decided and what is still open?
current_activity: Summarize the choice and its rationale in plain language. Invite correction, surface unresolved concerns and name a reconsideration trigger. Distinguish an agreed decision from a proposal awaiting permission.
strengths: Decision, rationale, unresolved concerns and revisit trigger are separated; correction is invited; proposals awaiting permission are not agreed decisions and silence is not consensus.
limitations_or_conditional_risks: The opening question can presuppose a decision exists or everyone shares understanding; when none exists, the activity’s pending-proposal distinction is essential.
recommendation_NOT_implemented: Retain the distinctions and allow no decision yet; avoid a required closing or universal consensus claim.
individual_team_adaptation: Solo leaves a rationale for future self; team checks corrections while leaving unresolved concerns visible.
relationship_audit: Catalog-only base question/action/activity/optional AI template are coherent for the stated focus; no paired Ask/Try/private Guide is authored and this identity is not in Classic12. Legacy question is reviewed as a catalog discussion prompt, not claimed as shipped Coaching Ask.
optional_agent_workflow_scope: No agent-workflow adaptation on this card; do not infer CLI-only purpose from the optional collection elsewhere.
suggested_validation_NOT_run: A reader should classify an unapproved proposal as pending and identify a revisit trigger without inferring consent.
tradeoff: A short summary supports transfer but cannot settle substantive disagreement by wording alone.
